paragraphs: Rabbi Avdimi bar Chama bar Chasa. “This teaches that He held the mountain over them like a tub,” Shabbat 88a. In Ein Yaakov, first chapter of Avodah Zarah, the reading in this account is bar Chama of Haifa. Horayot 10a: Avdimi bar Chama. Eruvin 55, beginning of a: bar Chama bar Dosa; one is a scribal error. Yuchasin lists him a second time: “Rabbi Dimi bar Chama b.Ch., and Rava spoke in his name; in chapter Rabbi Akiva: This teaches that He held the mountain like a tub.” End quotation. He grants the same document to two: under Dimi at dalet and Avdimi at alef. This too I did not find—that Rava spoke in his name.
